purpose: Model-neutral foundation realism comparison without identity conditioning
generic_subject: an adult Korean-Canadian woman who is a recreational swimmer, with a natural athletic build and ordinary unretouched appearance

seed_policy.pairing: Both models receive the identical seed for a camera hypothesis.

camera_hypotheses.name: indoor_public_pool_candid
camera_hypotheses.camera_type: recent consumer smartphone main camera, handheld
camera_hypotheses.action: pausing beside a lane after a swim while loosely holding goggles
camera_hypotheses.gaze_expression: looking just past the camera toward a friend, relaxed post-exertion half-smile

lighting.key: large side windows, cool daylight from camera right
lighting.fill: soft cyan bounce from pool water below
lighting.environment: uneven overhead municipal fixtures with mild highlight clipping

camera_hypotheses.material_state: damp hair and swimsuit, wet deck patches, dry towel on a bench
camera_hypotheses.wardrobe_sfw: opaque dark navy athletic one-piece swimsuit
camera_hypotheses.prompt: Photograph an adult Korean-Canadian woman who is a recreational swimmer, with a natural athletic build and ordinary unretouched appearance, pausing beside a lane after a swim and loosely holding goggles in an everyday municipal indoor pool. Vertical handheld consumer-phone photograph, 26 mm equivalent, camera 1.45 m high at 3.1 m, subject about 37% of frame. She looks just past the camera toward a friend with a relaxed post-exertion half-smile. Cool window key from camera right, cyan water bounce, uneven overhead fixtures. Opaque dark navy athletic one-piece, damp hair and fabric, wet deck patches, dry rumpled towel. Include a ladder and drain nearby, lanes and indistinct swimmers mid-distance, roof trusses and windows far back. Slight roll, mixed white balance, one clipped window patch, flyaways and minor phone noise; candid, physically coherent, no text or watermark.

camera_hypotheses.gaze_expression: downward gaze checking footing, neutral concentrated expression

lighting.key: late-afternoon sun filtered by a cloud from back-left

camera_hypotheses.material_state: streaming wet hair and suit, wet metal ladder, partly dry textured towel
camera_hypotheses.wardrobe_sfw: opaque deep green cross-back athletic one-piece swimsuit
deliberate_imperfections: one foot partly occluded by ladder
subtle motion blur on reaching hand
camera_hypotheses.prompt: Photograph an adult Korean-Canadian woman who is a recreational swimmer, with a natural athletic build and ordinary unretouched appearance, stepping up an outdoor pool ladder and reaching for a towel while carefully checking her footing. Vertical handheld compact-camera burst, 35 mm equivalent, camera 1.15 m high at 4 m, subject about 42% of frame. Late-afternoon cloud-filtered sun from back-left, open-sky fill from front-right, coherent water caustics. Opaque deep green cross-back athletic one-piece; streaming wet hair and fabric, wet ladder, partly dry textured towel. Ladder and droplets near, coping, changed lane markers and an empty chair mid-ground, hedge and low pavilion far back. Let the ladder partly occlude one foot, use subtle motion blur on the reaching hand, slightly cool auto white balance and natural shoulder tension; no text or watermark.
